name: Forest
descriptions: Tall oaks and beeches rise around you, their branches knitting a green roof overhead. Dappled light shifts on the leaf litter.
The forest floor is soft with moss and old leaves. Ferns crowd between the trunks, brushing your legs as you pass.
A fallen tree lies across the way, its bark furred with fungus. Beetles scurry along the rotting wood.
Birdsong fills the woods. Sunlight breaks through a gap in the canopy where an old tree has come down.
Thin saplings compete for light among older trees. A narrow deer track threads between them.
The ground dips toward a trickle of water that winds between mossy roots before disappearing under the leaves.
Acorns crunch underfoot beneath a sprawling oak whose lowest boughs nearly touch the ground.
Pale birches stand in a loose cluster, their peeling bark bright against the darker trunks beyond.

lines: A woodpecker drums in the distance.
